report_name: US Authorizes Private Sector to Conduct Offensive 'Hack-Back' Operations

identities.name: U.S. Department of Justice
identities.description: Co-leads the new National Coordination Center (NCC) to manage and oversee offensive cyber operations conducted by vetted private US companies.

identities.name: U.S. Department of Homeland Security
identities.description: Co-leads the new National Coordination Center (NCC) with the Department of Justice to manage and oversee offensive cyber operations.

identities.name: National Coordination Center
identities.description: A new center established under a U.S. presidential memorandum, jointly led by the DOJ and DHS, to manage and oversee offensive cyber operations conducted by vetted private sector partners against foreign criminal organizations.

identities.name: Transnational Criminal Organizations
identities.description: The designated foreign targets for offensive cyber operations under a new U.S. policy. The policy focuses on TCOs engaged in cybercrime such as ransomware, phishing, and financial fraud.
